title: GDPR Fines: Up to €20m or 4% of Turnover, No Per-Email Rate
meta_description: Article 83(5) caps GDPR fines at €20m or 4% of turnover, whichever is higher, with no per-email rate. What EDPB guidelines mean for small senders, and PECR.

image.takeaway: Article 83(5) caps GDPR fines at €20m or 4% of an undertaking’s turnover if higher, with no per-email rate.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on GDPR fines: Article 83(5) caps them at 20 million euros or, for an undertaking, 4% of worldwide annual turnover if higher, with no per-email rate.

chart.source: Basis: EDPB Guidelines 04/2022 v2.1 (24 May 2023) paras 60 and 65 and GDPR Art 83(5), hypothetical €3m firm. Source: edpb.europa.eu, read November 2026.
